dialogues.speaker: Boyan
dialogues.text: The market outlook's not been the best lately. I'd better stock up just in case...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you are...?

dialogues.speaker: Boyan
dialogues.text: Ah, dear guest, how fortunate that our paths should cross! Boyan's the name, "a merchant from Liyue" is the game.

dialogues.speaker: Boyan
dialogues.text: I transport goods from Liyue to Fontaine, and goods from Fontaine to Sumeru, and I pocket the difference. After all, everyone loves seeing things they've never seen before!

dialogues.speaker: Boyan
dialogues.text: A merchant's gotta keep their eyes peeled and their ears open. And I hear that tea's been on the downswing recently, and that's worrying news.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goods?

dialogues.speaker: Boyan
dialogues.text: If tea's your thing, know that the "Chenyu Adeptea" of Chenyu Vale is the very best there is.

dialogues.speaker: Boyan
dialogues.text: But there's been trouble in the vale's water and soil, and the tea quality's dropped like a rock in a river!

dialogues.speaker: Boyan
dialogues.text: This has troubled me day and night, and I can think of only one solution...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I shan't disturb you any longer.

dialogues.speaker: Boyan
dialogues.text: *sigh* I can't keep being so down. I'll scare my customers away...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you are...?

dialogues.speaker: Boyan
dialogues.text: Ah, dear guest, how fortunate that our paths should cross! Boyan's the name, "a merchant from Liyue" is the game.

dialogues.speaker: Boyan
dialogues.text: Our work's pretty tough, and risk is a constant companion, too. I haven't had a good night's sleep in several days now on account of that tea. Only now have I been able to heave a sigh of relief.

dialogues.speaker: Boyan
dialogues.text: *sigh* When will I be able to sit in a teahouse and just enjoy a cup of Chenyu Adeptea?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Supply problem?

dialogues.speaker: Boyan
dialogues.text: Indeed! Businesspeople like me fear blocked roads, robbed clientele, and worst of all, cut supplies!

dialogues.speaker: Boyan
dialogues.text: I've run routes throughout Teyvat for many years, building my reputation on naught but the excellent quality of my goods.

dialogues.speaker: Boyan
dialogues.text: Then, a few days ago, a wealthy gentleman ordered ten carts of Chenyu Adeptea from me...

dialogues.speaker: Boyan
dialogues.text: Only for there to be water and soil trouble in the vale... Even with the goods that I had stocked, I couldn't come up with ten carts!

dialogues.speaker: Boyan
dialogues.text: My reputation will be destroyed if I mix the top-grade goods with average stuff, but if I don't deliver on time at all...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I shan't disturb you any longer.

dialogues.speaker: Boyan
dialogues.text: Heh! There's much cheer to be had when things are going swell. Come by again if you've the time!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What way?

dialogues.speaker: Boyan
dialogues.text: Why, of course, I'll stock up on goods while spreading the word that "all is well in Chenyu Vale."

dialogues.speaker: Boyan
dialogues.text: And once everyone finds themselves unable to secure good tea leaves... Well...

dialogues.speaker: Boyan
dialogues.text: Oh dear, did I say too much?

dialogues.speaker: Boyan
dialogues.text: Ah, but you're the sort who can keep a secret, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You shouldn't have to worry about that now.

dialogues.speaker: Boyan
dialogues.text: Hmm? You're the well-informed sort, I see!

dialogues.speaker: Boyan
dialogues.text: Indeed, I hear tell that we have a Carp Adeptus's aid to thank...

dialogues.speaker: Boyan
dialogues.text: Well, not that I'd know much about this. All I know is that business is back on track!

dialogues.speaker: Boyan
dialogues.text: My brand was at stake for a moment there, but now that supply's been restored, I can sleep soundly again...
